title: Lionel Messi's Father Jorge Dies at 68
summary: Jorge Messi, father of soccer star Lionel Messi, has died at the age of 68. He passed away after a long illness in Rosario, Argentina. Jorge Messi was his son's first coach and later served as his agent, managing his career and business affairs. His death was confirmed by family and reported by numerous outlets.
summary_points: Jorge Messi, father of footballer Lionel Messi, died at age 68.
He passed away in Rosario, Argentina, following a long illness.
Jorge Messi was his son's initial coach and later his agent.
His death was confirmed by his family and reported by various media.
title_hi: लियोनेल मेसी के पिता जॉर्ज का 68 वर्ष की आयु में निधन
summary_hi: फुटबॉलर लियोनेल मेसी के पिता जॉर्ज मेसी का 68 वर्ष की आयु में निधन हो गया है। वह अर्जेंटीना के रोसारियो में लंबे समय से चली आ रही बीमारी के बाद दुनिया से चल बसे। जॉर्ज मेसी अपने बेटे के पहले कोच थे और बाद में उनके एजेंट के रूप में करियर और व्यावसायिक मामलों का प्रबंधन करते थे। उनके निधन की पुष्टि परिवार ने की और विभिन्न मीडिया आउटलेट्स ने इसकी सूचना दी।
